name: scene_and_interaction_evidence_query_network

architecture.object_encoder: frozen ROI/semantic features + box + typed selection evidence -> projection
architecture.history_encoder: one temporal Transformer layer with role/time/version masks
architecture.fusion: query self-attention -> object cross-attention -> history cross-attention -> FFN
architecture.injection: pi05 high-level VLM inputs_embeds only in first prototype

evidence_sources: privileged LIBERO or annotated scene for early prototype
synthetic BCI until real calibration exists
baseline_requirements: Full matched training and supervision controls
